name: Hip Rocker
instructions: Rock back towards, can go back at angle.

name: Knee Fallout
instructions: Bend knee and drop it out to side.

name: Windshield Wipers
instructions: Follow the exercise as demonstrated.

name: Glute Squeezes
instructions: Squeeze glutes but NOT Hamstrings or Quads hold for 10-20 sec.

name: Clam Shells, Modified
instructions: Roll forward don't lift very high 10-20 sec, point toe up.

name: Screwdriver
instructions: Put knee on swivel chair, rotate foot in and out, contract glute when foot rotates in.

name: Chest Stretch
instructions: Lock fingers behind back and lift up and down.

name: Hip Flexor Relief
instructions: Pull knee into chest as far as possible, move around to find most comfortable position, hold for 90 sec, release SLOWLY.

name: Isometric Lunge
instructions: Shift knee over toe for achilles tendon, and then do side lunge.

name: Isometric Squat
instructions: Follow the exercise as demonstrated.

name: Isometric Push Up
instructions: Don't need a lot of weight.

name: Calf Raise
instructions: Follow the exercise as demonstrated.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Can raise 1 leg to make it harder.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Can raise 1 leg to make it harder.

name: Wall T Hold
instructions: Palms forward, contract to push forearms into wall.

name: Dead Bug W Push
instructions: Lower leg to just off floor, hold 5 sec, then raise knee and push against it for 5 second.

name: Marching Bridge
instructions: Follow the exercise as demonstrated.

name: Psoas Cobra
instructions: Press up with hands, and press feet into wall.

name: Psoas Cobra Side To Side
instructions: Follow the exercise as demonstrated.

name: Hip Bridge, Soles Of Feet Together
instructions: Follow the exercise as demonstrated.

name: Romanian Dead Lift
instructions: Slide stick down front of legs, stick but out, keep back straight, until feel hamstrings tighten.

name: Wide Squat
instructions: Wide feet, toes outward.

name: Wall Lift Off
instructions: Face 6" off wall arm up, keep back straight lift arm back.

name: Chin Tucks With Should Retraction
instructions: Tuck chin, squeeze shoulders together.

name: Shoulder Blade Resist Band Retraction
instructions: Hold band with both hands in front, elbows at 90 degrees, move hands away from each other keeping elbows close to body. squeeze shoulder blades together.

name: Towel Roll Back Extension
instructions: Follow the exercise as demonstrated.

name: Lateral Monster Walk - Elastic Band AT Ankles Side Steps
instructions: Place a looped elastic band around both ankles. Next, bend your knees and step to the side while keeping tension on the band the entire time. After taking sidesteps to the side in one direction, reverse the direction taking sidesteps until you return to the starting position. Repeat.

name: Rows
instructions: Start with proper posture. -Arms extended out in front of you while holding bands. -Row handles towards side of armpits and then straight back out. -Keep elbows in close. -Pinch shoulder blades; contract the scapula. -Keep a braced core. -Keep shoulders down and away from ears.

name: Wall Angels
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall with arms raise to 90 degrees. While making contact with your head, wrists, elbows and shoulders, slide your arms up and down the wall as shown.

name: Banded Pull Apart
instructions: While holding an elastic band with your elbows straight in front of your body, pull your arms apart and towards the side. Once the band touches your chest, really try and squeeze the mid-back muscles to stretch the band even further. Hold for a few seconds and slowly return to the start position.

name: Upper Trap Stretch - Hand Behind Back AND TOP OF Head
instructions: Begin by retracting your head back into a chin tuck position. Next, place one hand behind your back and gently pull your head towards the opposite side with the help of your other arm.

name: Reverse Lunge Isometric
instructions: Engage core Hinge from the hip Maintain neutral pelvis Lunge backwards and hold

name: Levator Scapulae Stretch - Hand Behind Back AND TOP OF Head
instructions: Place your arm on the affected side behind your back and use your other hand to pull your head downward and towards the opposite side. You should be looking towards your opposite pocket of the target side.

name: Hip Adductor Isometric
instructions: Lay on your back. Knees up. Feet on the bed/floor. Place something between your knees that won't compact too much. A soccer ball or foam block is ideal. Squeeze your knees together. Use an intense squeeze, 70% of your strength or more. Hold the squeeze for time. Relax and repeat.

name: Supine HIP Abduction - Isometric
instructions: Wrap a belt or tie a sheet around your knees. While lying on your back attempt to pull apart your knees and hold.

name: Hip Internal Rotation Stretch
instructions: Lay on your back with feet spread wide. Lower one knee down, keeping it straight in line with your hip bone. You are looking for a stretch in your hip. Be sure to not let your pelvis come up as your leg goes down.

name: Quad Stretch - Standing
instructions: While in a standing position, bend your knee back behind and hold your ankle/foot. Next, gently pull your knee into a more bent position until a stretch is felt on the front of the thigh.

name: HIP Flexor Stretch Side Of Bed
instructions: While lying on a table or high bed, let the affected leg lower towards the floor until a stretch is felt along the front of your thigh.

name: Side Lying Clamshell - Clam Shell
instructions: While lying on your side with your knees bent, raise your top knee upwards while keeping your feet in contact the entire time. Lower back down and repeat. Do not let your pelvis roll back during the lifting movement.

name: Bridging
instructions: While lying on your back with knees bent, tighten your lower abdominals, squeeze your buttocks and then raise your buttocks off the floor/bed as creating a "Bridge" with your body. Hold and then lower yourself and repeat.

name: Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Place one knee on the ground and place the other leg out in front of you with a bent knee. Keep you abdominal muscles tight as you stretch out the front of your hip

name: Fire Hydrant - Quadruped HIP Abduction
instructions: Start in a crawl position and keeping knee at 90 raise your leg out to the side as shown. Maintain a straight upper and mid back.

name: Supine HIP Abduction - Elastic Band Clams - Clamshell
instructions: Lie down on your back with your knees bent. Place an elastic band around your knees and then pull your knees apart.

name: Bridging Elastic Band Abduction
instructions: While lying on your back, place an elastic band around your knees and pull your knees apart. Hold this and then tighten your lower abdominals, squeeze your buttocks and raise your buttocks off the floor/bed as creating a "Bridge" with your body.

name: Lateral Step Down
instructions: -Starting with standing on top of the steps with both feet. Bring your involved leg/foot to the edge of the step with letting opposite leg/foot hover. -Engage your core and quads and squat down; slowly lowering the opposite foot to the floor. Press hips and glutes back. -Avoid letting your knee go past your toes. -Keep knee in line with shoulder and toes. -Slowly press back up through

name: Ice Skater Lunge
instructions: Step behind and across. Bend both knees and push your hips back- taking you into a lunge. Make sure your core is tight and glutes engaged.

name: Reverse Lunge Sliders
instructions: Here I am challenging the right leg by reducing friction on the opposite foot and performing reverse lunge with minimal weight on slider/sock/towel. Be sure to hinge at the right hip and maintain weight over the arch of the foot (do not transfer weight on glider leg).

name: Banded Hip Flexor March
instructions: With both hands leaning into the wall and a band around the feet, drive the first knee up and hold in a flexed position while the stance leg extends both the hip and the knee. Keep the Flexed hip in a contracted/ isometric position for 3 seconds before switching feet.

name: Lateral Plank With Clams
instructions: While lying on your side with bent knees, lift your body up on your elbow and knees. Next, raise up the upper most knee. Repeat. Try and maintain a straight spine.

name: Bridge - Marching
instructions: While lying on your back, tighten your lower abdominal muscles, squeeze your buttocks and then raise your buttocks off the floor/bed as creating a "Bridge" with your body. While holding this position, lift one leg while maintaining a level pelvis. Set it back to the floor and then lift the opposite leg.
